eps.ov: When Jooheon Suh is mortally wounded in battle, a mysterious talking crow gives him another chance.

eps.t: Those Who Seek to Own Relics
eps.ov: Jooheon returns home only to find that a tomb has opened where his apartment used to be.
When the tomb housing the Masamune relic appears, Jooheon races to claim it before a foreigner can.

eps.t: The One Who Stole the Future
eps.ov: The Future Guide hints at a powerful relic that will be up for auction in Las Vegas.

eps.t: The Owner of the Tree of Life
eps.ov: Jooheon wins several relics at the Midas auction house, but Chairman Taejoon Kwon wastes no time tracking him down.
When Kwon tries to use his relic to force Jooheon into submission, its power awakens another set of relics.
Jooheon seeks out the aid of a certain individual to restore the relics that broke in his fight against Kwon.
Jooheon is offered a job finding a relic for the "Queen of War," an American military general.
Jooheon pockets the map relic he fetched for General Kiera and makes a plan to destroy her other map relics.
An international organization called Pandora is founded to keep relics out of the hands of citizens.
While searching for Tian Fu's Relic, Jooheon finds an underground tea field being worked by children.
Jooheon and Irene return to the Holton home to heal her parents... only to find that it's been attacked.
